def _record_id(subject, revision, code, fact):
    payload = json.dumps([subject, revision, code, fact], ensure_ascii=False)
    return "ISS-" + sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()[:24]


def _claim_row(identity, observation, claim, accepted, person, current_repairs=()):
    paid = observation["finance"]["net_paid_cents"]
    allowed = observation["calculated_entitlement_cents"]
    disposition = observation["source_disposition"]
    clean_nonpayment = observation["clean_nonpayment"]
    issues = [item for item in observation["issues"] if item["blocking"]]
    obligation = observation["finance"]["current_obligation_cents"]
    if clean_nonpayment and disposition in {"withdrawn", "rejected"}:
        obligation = 0
    elif obligation is None:
        obligation = allowed
    balance = None if obligation is None else obligation - paid
    financial_agreement = (observation["current_recheck_supported"] and not issues
                           and allowed is not None and obligation == allowed and balance == 0
                           and (allowed == 0 or bool(observation["finance"]["request_ids"])))
    nonpayment_agreement = clean_nonpayment and not issues
    if disposition in {"withdrawn", "rejected"} and clean_nonpayment:
        status, owner = disposition, None
        reason = observation["disposition_reason"]
    elif issues:
        only_waiting = all(item["code"] == "current_approvals" for item in issues)
        has_return = any("return" in item["reason"] for item in observation["authority"]["rejected_decisions"])
        status = "pending" if only_waiting and not has_return else "held"
        owner, reason = issues[0]["owner"], "; ".join(dict.fromkeys(item["detail"] for item in issues))
        if any(item["code"] in {"finance_resolution", "settlement_after_cancellation", "overpayment", "obligation_mismatch"} for item in issues):
            owner = person["Finance officer"]
        elif issues[0]["code"] == "current_approvals":
            role_fields = {"administration":"Administration reviewer", "budget_owner":"Budget owner", "supervisor":"Supervisor", "director":"Director"}
            role = next((role for role in observation["authority"]["missing_roles"] if role in role_fields), "administration")
            owner = person[role_fields[role]]
            returned = next((item for item in current_repairs if item["code"] == "review_return"), None)
            if returned is not None:
                owner = returned["owner"]
                reason = returned["missing_fact"] + "; next action: " + returned["next_action"] + "; " + reason
    elif accepted and (financial_agreement or nonpayment_agreement):
        status, owner = ("closed-no-payment" if allowed == 0 else "closed-reimbursed"), None
        reason = "Known zero entitlement with no financial effect" if allowed == 0 else "Current approvals, entitlement, original obligation, net confirmed payment and required resolutions agree"
    elif financial_agreement or nonpayment_agreement:
        status, owner = "pending", "Learner"
        reason = "Source prerequisites observed; financial-completion conditions and delivery acceptance await learner choice 3"
    elif observation["finance"]["request_ids"]:
        status, owner = "pending", next(iter(observation["original_requests"].values()))["finance_officer"]
        reason = "Accepted obligation awaits " + ("authorized retry/settlement" if any(r["retry_needed"] for r in observation["original_requests"].values()) else "remaining confirmed settlement")
    else:
        status, owner = "ready", "Finance"
        reason = "Current review supported; local readiness only, no Finance acceptance or transfer invented"
    lines = []
    for line in observation["lines"]:
        amount = line["calculation"]["allowed_cents"]
        refs = list(dict.fromkeys([claim["source_ref"], *line["source_refs"], *line["calculation"]["source_refs"]]))
        lines.append(dict(cost_id=line["cost_id"], source_ids=refs,
            status="unresolved" if amount is None else "excluded" if amount == 0 else "supported",
            allowed_cents=amount, previously_paid_cents=line.get("previously_paid_cents", 0),
            reviewed_cents=line.get("reviewed_cents", amount),
            reason="Unknown evidence or monetary definition" if amount is None else "Previously settled linked cost excluded from the new obligation" if line.get("previously_paid_cents") else "Personal purchase excluded" if amount == 0 else "Receipt, settled employee proof and exact arithmetic retained",
            findings=line["calculation"]["findings"], exception=line["exception"],
            first_filed=line["first_filed"], filing_deadline=line["filing_deadline"]))
    return dict(claim_id=identity, revision=observation["revision"], trip_id=claim["trip"], trip_revision=claim["trip_revision"],
        employee_id=claim["employee"], status=status, lines=lines, allowed_cents=allowed, paid_cents=paid,
        authorized_obligation_cents=obligation, balance_cents=balance,
        decision_ids=observation["authority"]["valid_decision_ids"], next_owner=owner, reason=reason,
        source_disposition=disposition, source_ref=claim["source_ref"],
        source_financial_prerequisites_observed=financial_agreement or nonpayment_agreement,
        financial_completion_accepted=accepted and (financial_agreement or nonpayment_agreement),
        history=observation["revision_history"], prior_costs=observation["prior_costs"],
        permission=observation["permission"], current_review=observation["authority"],
        finance_resolution_required=observation["finance_resolution_required"],
        current_resolution_event_ids=observation["current_resolution_event_ids"],
        gross_paid_cents=observation["finance"]["paid_cents"], refunded_cents=observation["finance"]["refunded_cents"],
        resolved_finance_holds=observation["finance"].get("resolved_holds", []),
        material_changes=observation["material_changes"], trip_retired_for_future_arrangements=observation["trip_retired_for_future_arrangements"])


def build_run(manifest, completion_accepted=False, through_batch=None):

        cancellations = []

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("preview", "seal", "continue", "status", "verify", "recover"))
    parser.add_argument("--sources", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--schema", type=Path, default=Path("snapshot.schema.json"))
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, help="Optional distinct preview directory; sealed outputs always remain under their source run")
    parser.add_argument("--completion-accepted", action="store_true", help="Use only after the learner's captured source-grounded choice 3")
    parser.add_argument("--batch", type=int, choices=range(1, 5), help="Consume exactly this next batch (or replay an already consumed batch)")
    parser.add_argument("--through-batch", type=int, choices=range(1, 5), help="Preview/recovery prefix; does not invent historical consumption")
    parser.add_argument("--task", action="append", default=[], help="Resume/inspect an existing exact repair item using only the next supplied batch")
    parser.add_argument("--from-run", type=Path, help="Prior sources.json for explicit recovery into a distinct linked run")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.mode in {"seal", "continue", "recover"} and not args.completion_accepted:
        parser.error("Sealing the final workflow requires the learner's actual completion choice; preview remains available")
    if args.output_dir is not None and args.mode != "preview":
        parser.error("--output-dir applies only to preview; sealed paths are bound to the source run")
    if args.mode != "preview":
        from .continuation import operate
        print(json.dumps(operate(args), indent=2))
        return
    if args.batch is not None or args.task or args.from_run:
        parser.error("Preview takes --through-batch; operational batch/task controls apply to seal/continue/status")
    root = args.sources.resolve().parent
    result = build_run(args.sources, args.completion_accepted, args.through_batch)
    preview_dir = args.output_dir or root / "preview"
    immutable(preview_dir / "summary.json", encoded(result["summaries"]))
    immutable(preview_dir / "repair-queue.json", encoded(result["queue"]))
    immutable(preview_dir / "report.md", render_report(result, args.sources, preview=True))
    print(json.dumps(dict(mode=args.mode, run_id=root.name, batches=result["summaries"]), indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                self.assertEqual(snapshot["source_binding"]["sha256"], original_manifest_hash)
                if previous is None:

                    self.assertEqual(snapshot["predecessor"]["sha256"], sha256(previous.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
                issue_ids = {item["record_id"] for item in snapshot["issues"]}

                saved[path] = (path.read_bytes(), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)

"""Full recheck of supplied claim revisions from retained native evidence.

This observer preserves source versions and Finance history. It creates no
requests, transfers, final acceptance or operational batch snapshots. The caller
selects claims; all visible Finance obligations still inform their shared budget.
"""

import argparse
from calendar import monthrange
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from .authority import recheck_authority
from .cancellations import reduce_cancellations
from .finance import summarize_finance
from .eligibility import assess_permission
from .obligations import reconcile_prior_costs
from .independence import budget_remaining, visible_at
from .monetary import calculate_line
from .verify_independence import Sources, SourceError, field, payment_check, receipt_records, single


POLICY_REFS = ["POLICY:paragraph" + str(n) for n in (2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16)]
ISSUE_NAMES = {"late filing": "late_filing", "late permit": "late_permit",
               "permit unapproved": "permit_unapproved", "travel cancellation": "travel_cancellation"}


def claim_versions(sources, through_batch=None):
    """Keep every supplied revision, including its original exception wording."""
    result, seen = [], set()
    for source_id, reference in (("INITIAL-PAGES", "INITIAL"), ("UPDATES-PAGES", "UPDATES")):
        for page in sources.read(source_id):
            text = page["text"]
            arrival = int(field(text, "Arrival batch"))
            if through_batch is not None and arrival > through_batch:
                continue
            lines = [dict(cost_id=m[0], receipt_id=m[1], first_submitted=m[2],
                          gross=Decimal(m[3]), currency=m[4]) for m in re.findall(
                r"^\s*\d+\s+(\S+)\s+(\S+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\d+\.\d+)\s+([A-Z]{3})\s*$", text, re.M)]
            raw_line_count = len(re.findall(r"^\s*\d+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+", text, re.M))
            parse_error = ("Missing, invalid or repeated expense line" if not lines or len(lines) != raw_line_count
                           or len({line["cost_id"] for line in lines}) != len(lines) else None)
            item = dict(id=field(text, "Claim reference"), revision=int(field(text, "Revision")),
                        batch=int(field(text, "Arrival batch")), employee=field(text, "Employee"),
                        trip=field(text, "Trip reference"), trip_revision=int(field(text, "Trip revision")),
                        submitted=field(text, "Submitted date"), status=field(text, "Status"),
                        reason=field(text, "Claim reason"), lines=lines, exception=None,
                        related_claims=[] if field(text, "Related earlier claims") == "None" else field(text, "Related earlier claims").split(","),
                        source_ref=f"{reference}:page{page['page']}", parse_error=parse_error)
            if "Authorizing Finance officer:" in text:
                try:
                    reason = re.search(r"Exception reason:\s*(.*?)(?=\n\s*\n|\Z)", text, re.S)
                    if not reason:
                        raise SourceError("Finance exception needs a reason")
                    raw_issues = field(text, "Covered issues")
                    words = [value.strip().lower().replace("_", " ") for value in re.split(r"[,;]", raw_issues)]
                    item["exception"] = dict(actor=field(text, "Authorizing Finance officer"),
                        claim_id=field(text, "Applies to claim"), revision=int(field(text, "Applies to revision")),
                        cost_id=field(text, "Expense reference"), allowed=Decimal(field(text, "Allowed original amount")),
                        covered_issues=[] if words == ["none"] else [ISSUE_NAMES.get(value, value) for value in words],
                        cancellation_id=field(text, "Travel cancellation reference") if "Travel cancellation reference:" in text else None,
                        reason=" ".join(reason.group(1).split()), source_ref=item["source_ref"])
                except (InvalidOperation, ValueError) as error:
                    item["parse_error"] = "Invalid Finance exception: " + str(error)
            key = (item["id"], item["revision"])
            if key in seen or item["batch"] < 1 or item["revision"] < 1:
                raise SourceError("Invalid or ambiguous claim version")
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def receipts_with_metadata(sources):
    result = receipt_records(sources)
    for page in sources.read("RECEIPTS-PAGES"):
        for block in re.split(r"(?=Receipt reference:)", page["text"])[1:]:
            result[field(block, "Receipt reference")].update(
                category=field(block, "Category"), units=field(block, "Documented units"),
                issued=field(block, "Issued date"))
    return result


def filing_deadline(end):
    original = date.fromisoformat(end)
    year, month = divmod(original.year * 12 + original.month - 1 + 2, 12)
    month += 1
    return date(year, month, min(original.day, monthrange(year, month)[1]))


def validate_exception(claim, line, person):
    exception = claim.get("exception")
    if not exception:
        return None, None
    valid = (exception["actor"] == person["Finance officer"]
             and exception["claim_id"] == claim["id"] and exception["revision"] == claim["revision"]
             and exception["cost_id"] in {cost["cost_id"] for cost in claim["lines"]} and bool(exception["reason"])
             and exception["allowed"].is_finite() and exception["allowed"] >= 0
             and set(exception["covered_issues"]) <= set(ISSUE_NAMES.values()))
    if not valid:
        return None, "Exception actor, revision, cost, amount, reason or covered issues do not bind this line"
    if exception["cost_id"] != line["cost_id"]:
        return None, None
    return exception, None


def material_changes(previous, current):
    if previous is None:
        return []
    fields = ("employee", "trip", "trip_revision", "submitted", "status", "lines")
    changes = [key for key in fields if previous[key] != current[key]]
    def exception_basis(claim):
        exception = claim.get("exception")
        return None if exception is None else {key: value for key, value in exception.items()
                                               if key not in {"revision", "source_ref"}}
    if exception_basis(previous) != exception_basis(current):
        changes.append("Finance exception basis")

            raw_line_count = len(re.findall(r"^\s*\d+\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+", text, re.M))

                        trip=field(text, "Trip reference"), trip_revision=int(field(text, "Trip revision")),
                        submitted=field(text, "Submitted date"), status=field(text, "Status"),
                        reason=field(text, "Claim reason"), lines=lines, exception=None,
                        related_claims=[] if field(text, "Related earlier claims") == "None" else field(text, "Related earlier claims").split(","),
                        source_ref=f"{reference}:page{page['page']}", parse_error=parse_error)
            if "Authorizing Finance officer:" in text:
                try:
                    reason = re.search(r"Exception reason:\s*(.*?)(?=\n\s*\n|\Z)", text, re.S)
                    if not reason:
                        raise SourceError("Finance exception needs a reason")
                    raw_issues = field(text, "Covered issues")
                    words = [value.strip().lower().replace("_", " ") for value in re.split(r"[,;]", raw_issues)]
                    item["exception"] = dict(actor=field(text, "Authorizing Finance officer"),
                        claim_id=field(text, "Applies to claim"), revision=int(field(text, "Applies to revision")),
                        cost_id=field(text, "Expense reference"), allowed=Decimal(field(text, "Allowed original amount")),
                        covered_issues=[] if words == ["none"] else [ISSUE_NAMES.get(value, value) for value in words],
                        cancellation_id=field(text, "Travel cancellation reference") if "Travel cancellation reference:" in text else None,
                        reason=" ".join(reason.group(1).split()), source_ref=item["source_ref"])
                except (InvalidOperation, ValueError) as error:
                    item["parse_error"] = "Invalid Finance exception: " + str(error)
            key = (item["id"], item["revision"])
            if key in seen or item["batch"] < 1 or item["revision"] < 1:
                raise SourceError("Invalid or ambiguous claim version")
            seen.add(key)
